description: Building a GTFS-Flex Feed from Published Stop Coordinates: Demand Responsive Transport in Yatomi City, Aichi, Japan is a model or code deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Yasutoshi Moteki (Nanzan University). Yatomi City (Aichi Prefecture, Japan) operates a demand-responsive transport service, Choisoko Yatomi, for which no GTFS feed is published. Coverage: national (JP); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is MIT. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
